item.title: Kalshi loses appeal, setting up potential Supreme Court case
item.description: The 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals ruled against prediction market Kalshi, siding with Ohio and Tennessee on regulating sports-event contracts under state laws.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to leave post on Oct. 2
item.description: Peirce, known as “Crypto Mom,” served on the SEC for about eight years, including as director of the Crypto Task Force.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: CFTC sues Cash FX, alleges $950M crypto-linked forex scheme
item.description: The CFTC claimed that Cash FX engaged in minimal forex trading and misappropriated most of the participant funds.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: OG.com seeks CFTC approval for single-stock perpetual futures
item.description: OG.com, recently spun out of Crypto.com, joins Coinbase, Kalshi and Kraken parent Payward in seeking approval to bring perpetual futures to individual US stocks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Ex-CFTC leader to leave Blockchain Association after CLARITY vote fails
item.description: Former CFTC Commissioner Summer Mersinger joined the Blockchain Association in 2025 after resigning during her second term at the federal commodities regulator.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Tether says it had ‘limited’ exposure to bank linked to $84M US seizure
item.description: US prosecutors alleged that a payments business illegally transferred hundreds of millions of dollars at the direction of EQIBank, where Tether holds some assets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Former Hack VC partner Hsin-Ju Chuang’s death ruled a suicide
item.description: The crypto executive and Dystopia Labs founder previously held senior roles at Stellar and Solana before joining venture capital firm Hack VC.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitget clarifies $388M in assets affected by security breach
item.description: The Bitget breach announced on Thursday affected about $35 million more than previously reported, based on an analysis of assets on Zcash and TRON.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Strategy seeks shareholder approval for daily preferred stock dividends
item.description: Strategy’s proposal would move STRC and its three other preferred stocks to daily dividend payments, following a similar move by Bitcoin treasury firm Strive.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street and crypto fight for the same turf
item.description: Stablecoins and tokenized assets are pushing banks, exchanges and crypto companies into the same markets, from payments to stocks and ETFs.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Exchanges reporting crypto gains to IRS becomes tax nightmare
item.description: The IRS can now see your crypto gains, but has no idea about the cost-basis. That’s proving to be a big headache for some cryptocurrency investors.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: CoinMarketCap buys CoinGlass to expand crypto derivatives data
item.description: CoinGlass will retain its brand and team, while its website, app, free tools, API and pricing will remain unchanged following the acquisition.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: SlowMist has yet to confirm crypto theft from iPhone Safari attack
item.description: The analyzed Safari sample targets iOS 18.4–18.6.2 using previously patched flaws, while its effectiveness on iOS 26.5 remains unverified.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: IBIT options price trading more calmly after Bitcoin rebound
item.description: IBIT’s expected volatility sits near the bottom of its 12-month range, according to Saxo Bank’s analysis of options data from Sept. 23.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Magic Eden scare puts 3,832 NFTs in whitehat protective custody
item.description: Yuga Labs’ 0xQuit said the NFTs are safe and will be returned once the risk passes, while holders were urged to revoke NFT permissions.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: KelpDAO sues LayerZero, CEO over $292M rsETH bridge exploit
item.description: KelpDAO says LayerZero endorsed its bridge setup before the attack, while CEO Bryan Pellegrino has dismissed the lawsuit as meritless.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows slow to $191M as six-day streak reaches $2.8B
item.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $191 million Thursday as daily inflows slowed for a third day, lifting year-to-date net flows to $787 million.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Samourai Wallet co-founder faces transfer after 30-day jail ordeal
item.description: Keonne Rodriguez says he and 70 others face another move after their treatment program was deactivated. His previous transfer took 30 days.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Australian PM warns of AI’s ‘furious pace’ after agent breached government site
item.description: Anthony Albanese said governments must help shape AI’s development, after revealing earlier that an OpenAI agent accessed non-public files on an Australian Medicare data portal.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Researchers propose Zcash-style private Bitcoin transfers without a soft fork
item.description: Shielded Bitcoin would use zero-knowledge proofs and encrypted notes to hide transaction details without changing Bitcoin consensus, but researchers have raised questions about anonymity and quantum resistance.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Block brings Bitcoin Lightning payments to x402 for AI agents
item.description: Block joins Google, Microsoft, AWS and Coinbase in backing x402, an open payment standard enabling agentic AI commerce.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Bitget CEO suspects North Korea behind $352M hack, citing IP clues
item.description: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen said a preliminary investigation found IP addresses matching VPN choices associated with a DPRK hacking group.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Asia dominates Crypto Adoption Index, Bitget’s $352M hack: Asia Express
item.description: The APAC region accounts for half of the Global Crypto Adoption Index. Bitget suffers massive $352M loss and OpenAI forgets to mention its agents hacked the Australian Government.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: Fed proposes new capital, redemption rules for stablecoin issuers
item.description: The Fed’s proposal would set capital requirements, a two-day redemption window and new reserve disclosures as regulators implement the GENIUS Act.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitget confirms $352M security breach, suspends withdrawals
item.description: Bitget said unauthorized transfers affected a limited number of hot wallets, while cold wallets and most platform assets remained unaffected.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: CFTC updates guidance on tokenized assets, blockchain records after failed vote
item.description: Although the CFTC chair did not say the failed vote on the CLARITY Act was behind new rules for authorized crypto entities, he said the move was “to provide regulatory clarity.“
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Bitcoin price steadies, ONDO rallies as US Treasury yields hit 2007 highs
item.description: US Treasury yields hit a 19-year high on Thursday, pressuring risk assets as Bitcoin held near $84,000 and ONDO became top performer among altcoins.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Charles Bennett

item.title: DoubleZero brings dedicated fiber market data to Hyperliquid traders
item.description: DoubleZero launched a dedicated fiber market data feed for Hyperliquid, giving professional trading firms faster access to its full order book.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Crypto treasury model loses its edge as stock premiums fade: DWF
item.description: Most DATs now trade below the value of their crypto holdings, weakening a financing model that once helped companies expand their balance sheets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi
